SECRET.

PF 46464/B.1.a/GPW.  9th January, 1947.

Dear Philby,

Karl GROENL @ Stanislas RETZLAW.

Further to our PF 46464/B.1.a/GPW of the 14th October, 1946, on the above named German, it has now been reported that he is closely connected with the "Mouvement pour le rattachement de la Sarre" and is a regular contributor to its organ "Neue Saar".

Yours sincerely,

G.P. Wethered.

H.A.R. Philby, Esq., O.B.E., S.I.B.

GPW/EDA.
